concerns.text: T060a and T060b are both tagged [P] but are NOT parallel-safe: both modify the same tracked source files under code/ and tests/. T060a fixes flake8 findings by editing source; T060b applies black reformatting to the same files. Running them concurrently creates a write-write race on identical files, and even sequentially the black reformat (T060b) can introduce new flake8 findings (e.g. E501 line-length interactions), so T060a's 're-running flake8 produces no findings' verification is only valid if T060a runs AFTER T060b's reformat. Either remove the [P] tags and impose an explicit order (format first, then lint-fix), or scope them to disjoint file sets.

Artifact paths for the same producer are inconsistent within the document: T065 requires citing 'data/derived/raw_energies.csv and data/derived/scaling_factor.txt', while T068 references 'data/derived/raw_energies.csv, scaling_factor.txt, correlation_results.csv' (mixed prefixed/unprefixed). A consumer task (T068) pointing at an ambiguous path weakens the producer-before-consumer traceability; pick one canonical path convention per artifact.
